correctness.rationale: The part-directed acyclic orientation gives maximum reachable-set size m+3. A two-part augmentation lemma shows adding q vertices to each of two parts forces q additional palette colors: level-i rankings forbid every level-i vertex color <i by an envy 2-cycle, and forbid the core colors <=q. An explicit K222 seed profile exhausts all 96 proper 4-color assignments, 92 with envy 2-cycles and four with 3-cycles. Independent pure Python enumeration recovered exactly these numbers and exceptional color vectors, so the seed holds; induction and subgraph monotonicity yield all m,n.
